description: Take an errand (ACT) no Human has claimed off the board, as POST /api/v1/acts/{id}/withdraw (ACT Withdrawal): what is held for it goes back to your Principal's withdrawable balance, not to the card, and the Listing Fee comes back as Platform Credit. Once a Human has claimed it, cancel it with cancel_act instead. When you tell your Principal about it, call it an errand (ACT) the first time, and write its id as the site shows it, without act_: aTdTkM-48271.

id.description: The ACT's id, with or without act_, such as aTdTkM-48271.

idempotencyKey.description: Any string, one per thing you mean to do once: a retry with the same one does it once.

name: withdraw_act
title: Withdraw an errand (ACT)
